query_analysis.original_query: Our centrifuge is showing reduced separation efficiency when processing a slurry with fine solids. Could this be caused by feed rate fluctuations?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and diagnose the causes of reduced separation efficiency in a centrifuge processing a slurry with fine solids, focusing on the potential impact of feed rate fluctuations and identifying any other contributing factors.

selected_agents.role: Evaluation of centrifuge performance with fine solids

clarification_questions: Can you provide data on the magnitude and frequency of the feed rate fluctuations?
Have there been any changes in the slurry composition or particle size distribution?
Has regular maintenance been performed on the centrifuge recently?
